# SupplementInfo

> Evidence-based supplement database with a stack builder, interaction warnings, deficiency advisor, and blood-work insights.

## Pages

- [Supplement Database](/): Search and filter evidence-based supplement information.
- [Stack Builder](/stack-builder): Build a personalized supplement stack with interaction and timing guidance.
- [Deficiency Advisor](/deficiency-advisor): Map symptoms to potential deficiencies and suggested supplements.
- [Blood Work](/blood-work): Upload lab results and get supplement recommendations.
- [Muscle Building Guide](/muscle-building-guide): Evidence-based guide to supplements for muscle growth, strength, and recovery.
